title: NearWave Founder Gives ‘Hot Topics’ Talk at ECBO Conference
summary: NearWave Founder Dr. Thomas O’Sullivan was invited to speak on Diffuse Optical Spectroscopy and Imaging at the European Conference on Biomedical Optics, where he served as Conference Chair.
body_markdown:
NearWave Founder Dr. Thomas O’Sullivan was invited to speak on Diffuse Optical Spectroscopy and Imaging at the European Conference on Biomedical Optics, where he served as Conference Chair.
